paraphrase.proposes: The track makes the marker vocabulary guard accept the canonical pending marker `- [ ] ` and fail only a marker outside {space, ~, x, b}, and it rewords catalog entry A8 to state that set. It changes measure/doctor.sh so step 4 runs the architecture check in CI mode with a captured exit code, prints the verdict and the owner track, and no longer sets the gate exit code for a verdict of 0 or 1; a tool failure, any code other than 0 or 1, still fails the gate. The three structural guard steps keep gating the exit code. The track adds two guard tests, a gate record file, and a registry status update, and it changes no product file, no manifest, no gate file, and no PM role file. The goal is `bash measure/doctor.sh` exits 0 on master by 2026-11-14. Option (C) is a default that waits for the PM confirmation.
